1.text: Iyi ndirimbo yitwa Zaburi, yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi.Mwa bari mu isi yose mwe,Muvugirize Imana impundu.

2.text: Muririmbe icyubahiro cy'izina ryayo,Mwogeze ishimwe ryayo.

3.text: Mubwire Imana muti“Imirimo yawe ko iteye ubwoba,Imbaraga zawe nyinshi zizatuma abanzi bawe bose bakugomokera,Bakagushyeshya.

4.text: Abo mu isi yose bazagusenga bakuririmbire,Bazaririmbira izina ryawe.”Sela.

5.text: Nimuze murebe imirimo y'Imana,Iteye ubwoba ku byo igirira abantu.

6.text: Yahinduye inyanja ubutaka,Kandi bambukishije uruzi ibirenge,Aho ni ho twayishimiriye.

7.text: Itegekesha imbaraga zayo iteka,Amaso yayo yitegereza amahanga,Abagome be kwishyira hejuru.Sela.

8.text: Mwa mahanga mwe, muhimbaze Imana yacu,Mwumvikanishe ijwi ry'ishimwe ryayo.

9.text: Irindira imitima yacu mu bugingo,Kandi ntikundira ibirenge byacu ko biteguza.

10.text: Kuko Mana, waratugerageje,Watuvugutiye nk'uko bavugutira ifeza.

11.text: Wadutoje ikigoyi,Waduhekesheje umutwaro uremereye mu mugongo.

12.text: Wahaye abantu kudukandagiza ku mitwe amafarashi abahetse,Twanyuze mu muriro no mu mazi,Maze udukuramo udushyira ahantu h'uburumbuke.

13.text: Ndinjirana ibitambo byokeje mu nzu yawe,Ndaguhigura umuhigo naguhize.

14.text: Wabumbuje iminwa yanjye,Akanwa kanjye kakawuvuga ubwo nari mu mubabaro.

15.text: Ndagutambira ibitambo byokeje by'amatungo abyibushye,Arimo umubabwe w'amasekurume y'intama,Ndatamba amapfizi n'ihene.Sela.

16.text: Mwa bubaha Imana mwese mwe, nimuze mwumve.Nanjye ndavuga ibyo yakoreye ubugingo bwanjye.

18.text: Iyaba naribwiraga ibyo gukiranirwa mu mutima wanjye,Uwiteka ntaba anyumviye.

19.text: Ariko koko Imana iranyumviye,Ityarije ugutwi ijwi ryo gusenga kwanjye.

20.text: Imana ihimbazwe,Itanze kumva gusenga kwanjye,Kandi itankuyeho imbabazi zayo.
